name: Vale Migizi-Thammasak
location: The Rookery — dense vertical housing, gang-controlled, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Vale Migizi-Thammasak is compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 30, scars map his face like a transit diagram of bad decisions and worse luck. The chrome is visible — subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm — and he makes no effort to hide it.

He came up through the Shelf's informal apprentice system, learning the trade from runners who didn't survive long enough to see him surpass them. He works as a smuggler out of The Rookery, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

In a city full of people who talk about what they'll do, Vale Migizi-Thammasak is one of the ones who actually does it.

core_fears: Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
core_desires: Enough Quanta to buy out of the life — a clean identity and passage out of GLMZ
The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
Control — over their body, their schedule, their future
coping_mechanisms: Violence — hits something when they can't process emotions, preferably something that deserves it
Control — micromanages everything within reach to compensate for the chaos everywhere else
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
blind_spots: Mistakes pattern recognition for wisdom — sees connections that aren't there
Assumes their skill set is more transferable than it actually is
Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
psychology.secret: Alper Inoue-Aidoo is slowly going chrome-sick — rejection symptoms are manageable now but getting worse. Has maybe two years before it becomes visible.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse to the point of rudeness. Treats words like ammunition — expensive and not to be wasted.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
Calls money 'weight' — as in 'that job doesn't carry enough weight'
example_lines: "Contraband is just cargo that hasn't been properly introduced to the right people."
"Every border is a suggestion. Every checkpoint is a negotiation."
"I move things from where they are to where they need to be. The legality is your problem."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Alper Inoue-Aidoo's reputation — and a price for silence
Someone is impersonating Alper Inoue-Aidoo on jobs, and the impersonator is better at the work than the original
A corporate black site Alper Inoue-Aidoo once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know his face
narrative_function: Alper Inoue-Aidoo functions as a connector — his work puts him in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving him naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm. Geneware muscle density treatment — looks natural, hits like chrome
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Carefully managed deference that conceals a thorough assessment of their vulnerabilities.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Competitive but reliable. Will challenge decisions but never abandon the team.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Superficially friendly, internally cataloguing exits and weapons. The smile is real; the relaxation isn't.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Goes quiet. The silence is not calm — it's the sound of every contingency being evaluated simultaneously.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
breaking_points: Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out
Being forced to choose between a crew member and the mission — and choosing wrong

cyberware_inventory.name: Subdermal weapon mount
cyberware_inventory.description: Subdermal weapon mount — pop-out blade in each forearm

cyberware_inventory.name: Geneware muscle density treatment
cyberware_inventory.description: Geneware muscle density treatment — looks natural, hits like chrome

physical_description.heritage: Indigenous American (70.5%) with Southeast Asian (17.2%) and Northern European (12.3%) ancestry. The dominant Indigenous American heritage creates strong angular facial structure with prominent cheekbones, broad nose bridge, and solid bone composition. Southeast Asian ancestry refines the eye shape into slightly hooded lids with an alert, assessing quality, and adds definition to the lower face and jaw. Northern European ancestry introduces cooler undertones that create subtle tonal contrast—visible along the jawline and temples—modulating the warmer base into visual complexity.
physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled, low center of gravity. Wide shoulders tapering to a narrow waist. Built for impact absorption and explosive movement rather than reach or speed. No wasted mass.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Cropped close, military-clean, reveals the shape of his skull
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium warm brown with golden-copper undertones from Indigenous American heritage. Southeast Asian ancestry adds subtle olive-jade cast throughout, particularly visible on cheekbones and across the bridge of the nose. Northern European ancestry introduces cooler undertones along the jawline and temples, creating warm-dominant tonal complexity with cool modulation.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and scarred. Severe grooming habits mask poor skin condition underneath. Dark circles under eyes from sleep debt and cycle stimulants. A thin white line runs from left temple to jaw—old blade work. Nose broken at least twice and set without professional care.
distinguishing_marks: Pale scar tissue running from left temple to left jawline, approximately 12cm, thin and surgical-looking—contradicted by the jagged character of the surrounding skin
Burn marks across the knuckles of both hands, old and faded to pale pink, consistent with repeated exposure to friction or thermal stress
Small circular scar on right forearm just below the elbow—intervention point for the subdermal blade mount, still visible as a faint raised line despite years of healing
Matching circular scar on left forearm in identical location
White stress fracture lines visible under the skin of both forearms where geneware muscle density treatment has been applied—subtle rippling effect under normal lighting
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Subdermal weapon mounts in both forearms are visible as faint circular scarring and a subtle ridge of reinforced tissue running the length of each forearm. Chrome deliberately exposed—no attempt to hide the blade deployment mechanisms. Geneware muscle density treatment visible as unnatural muscle definition and subtle shimmer or rippling effect under the skin of the arms and shoulders when he moves.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and predatory. Moves from the hips and shoulders, not the limbs. No wasted motion. Stands with weight distributed on the balls of his feet, ready to shift in any direction instantly. Eyes track movement constantly. Default expression is neutral-to-hostile. When at rest, he's coiled rather than relaxed.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian. Black reinforced work pants with cargo pockets and tool loops—worn, maintained, practical. Sleeveless compression undershirt showing off the augmented forearms deliberately. Matte-black tactical jacket with Velcro patch sections for identification—usually blank. Scuffed combat boots, steel-toed, broken in through heavy use. Everything is dark, everything is functional, nothing is decorative. Designed to survive contact with edges, heat, and blood. No corporate logos, no gang colors, no affiliation markers—deliberate neutrality.
